The cheapest plan is to defer everyone and drive nothing. Likhu school is reachable only over two damaged roads, so its 5 people must be deferred. Rescuing the 7 adults would cost more in driving than the 20-minute penalty per adult that deferring them incurs. The best trip (4 adults from Trishuli, round trip 120 minutes) costs more than the 80-minute penalty for those four, so every rescue trip is worse than deferring.

<plan>
defer likhu-school injured 4
defer likhu-school child 1
defer thakre-market adult 3
defer trishuli-market adult 4
</plan>

COST: 520
